EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Source reported on own initiative that voice communications jamming is reported at Nyhavn, a different phenomenon with similar vocabulary.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: 2nd Naval Auxiliary Group.

3. Source assessed approximately 20 personnel involved, drawn from military rather than civilian establishment, which source described as without precedent in 14 months of access.

4. Source noted that instructions were passed verbally rather than through the usual written schedule, which source considered unusual.
